consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 9/26/81 show at War Memorial Auditorium was a high-energy performance with standout moments throughout both sets. The second set, in particular, is praised for its seamless transitions and powerful renditions of classic songs, making it one of the best shows of the year.
